versions.ghc: The Glorious Glasgow Haskell Compilation System, version 9.10.2

result.name: local-one-follower-three-browser
result.inputScope: actual Shift key on the focused product transcript to two animation frames, including driver/native main-thread delay; does not replace the existing frontend local-interaction suite

slowObserver.scope: server-side proxy socket read pause/disconnection; not a claim of kernel send-buffer saturation

inferredHelperStarts.basis: current one-helper-per-successful-follower-HTTP mapping; failures before network are unobserved

limitations: Three witnesses are correlated views of the same 100 source events, not 300 independent samples.
Visible high water represents coalesced committed progress; intermediate sequences may be superseded.
Missing old-path progress remains censored; no completion percentile is invented.
Dispatch measurement includes server dispatch plus loopback receipt and is not an exact send timestamp.
